system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the Boulangerie mutual exclusion algorithm. It extends the Boulanger specification and overrides the natural number type with a finite range, adding a state constraint to keep ticket numbers within bounds during model checking.
actors_and_components: Same as the Boulanger specification: N concurrent processes competing for mutual exclusion. This module adds a constant for the upper bound on natural numbers.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the Boulanger specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the Boulanger specification, but with natural numbers restricted to a finite range from 0 to the configured maximum.
actions: Inherits all actions from the Boulanger specification without modification.
safety_properties: Inherits from the Boulanger specification: mutual exclusion, type correctness, and the full inductive invariant.
model_bounds: N is set to 3 processes. The maximum natural number value is set to 3. The infinite set of natural numbers is overridden with the finite range 0 through the maximum value. A state constraint ensures that all process ticket numbers remain strictly below the maximum value, pruning states where ticket numbers would exceed the finite range.
additional_assumptions: This module is designed for model checking only. It uses the full behavioral specification (not the inductive specification). The state constraint prevents exploration of states where any ticket number reaches the maximum, ensuring the finite override of natural numbers does not cause spurious errors.
